programme.desc: Comandos das Forças Especiais são sequestrados em plena operação por uma nave espacial misteriosa e, ao despertar, tornam-se vítimas de uma raça alienígena implacável em uma luta pela sobrevivência.
programme.title: Osíris

programme.desc: Daniel é um rapaz prodigioso que fica deslumbrado com as conquistas a partir de sua capacidade excepcional para hackear sistemas, tornando-se o maior hacker do país.
programme.title: O Rei da Internet

programme.desc: Com um novo parceiro canino, um homem busca justiça depois que uma gangue ataca sua família.
programme.title: Farejando Vingança 2 - Cidade dos Lobos

programme.desc: Um agente oferece ajuda para cuidar de Shaw em troca do resgate de um "hacker". Dessa vez, não se trata apenas de velocidade: a corrida é pela sobrevivência.
programme.title: Velozes & Furiosos 7

programme.desc: Rick e Evelyn O'Connell estão morando na Londres de 1935, onde criam o filho. Quando uma série de eventos revela o corpo de Imhotep ressuscitado, os O'Connell iniciam uma corrida desesperada para salvar o mundo do mal e resgatar o filho antes que seja tarde demais.
programme.title: O Retorno da Múmia

programme.desc: Uma ex-agente da KGB que virou chef usa suas habilidades letais para salvar seu restaurante de um sindicato do crime que quer cobrar uma dívida de seu marido.
programme.title: Calor Mortal

programme.desc: Constance Bonacieux é sequestrada diante dos olhos de D'Artagnan. Em uma busca frenética para salvá-la, o jovem mosqueteiro, auxiliado por Athos, Porthos e Aramis, é forçado a unir forças com a misteriosa Milady de Winter.
programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros - Milady

programme.desc: Recém-casados, John e Jenny Grogan se mudam de Michigan para a Flórida. Lá, o casal compra sua primeira casa e encontra trabalho em jornais concorrentes. Mais tarde, John e Jenny adotam Marley, um adorável filhote de labrador amarelo.
programme.title: Marley & Eu

programme.desc: Noé vive com a esposa Naameh e os filhos Sem, Cam e Jafé em um mundo devastado pelo pecado, onde os homens perseguem e matam mutuamente. Um dia, Noé recebe uma missão divina: construir uma imensa arca para abrigar os animais durante um dilúvio.
programme.title: Noé

programme.desc: Memo, um pastor de ovelhas com deficiência mental, vive com sua filha e avó em uma vila na costa turca do mar Egeu. Um dia, sua vida é virada de cabeça para baixo quando a filha do comandante morre e Memo é acusado do assassinato e condenado à morte.
programme.title: Milagre na Cela 7

programme.desc: William Thacker é dono de uma livraria em Londres. A monotonia de sua existência é tumultuada romanticamente quando a famosa atriz estadunidense Anna Scott aparece em sua loja. Um encontro fortuito sobre um suco de laranja derramado leva a um beijo que dá início a um caso de amor. Conforme ele e a glamorosa estrela de cinema se aproximam cada vez mais, eles lutam para conciliar seus estilos de vida radicalmente diferentes em nome do amor.
programme.title: Um Lugar Chamado Notting Hill

programme.desc: O leão Alex é o rei da selva urbana, a principal atração no zoológico de Nova York. Ele e seus melhores amigos - a zebra Marty, a girafa Melman e a hipopótamo fêmea Gloria - sempre viveram em cativeiro, felizes, com refeições regulares e um público para adorá-los. No entanto, Marty quer explorar o mundo e foge com a ajuda dos pinguins.
programme.title: Madagascar

programme.desc: Dois agentes infiltrados revelam subitamente suas identidades durante uma negociação de cartel, cada um sem saber que o outro trabalhava no mesmo caso. A surpresa dura pouco quando uma chuva de balas os deixa encurralados e sob fogo pesado.
programme.title: Sob Fogo

programme.desc: Após forjar o próprio suicídio, um cientista enlouquecido usa seu poder para se tornar invisível e aterrorizar sua ex-namorada. Quando a polícia se recusa a acreditar em sua história, ela decide resolver o assunto por conta própria.

programme.desc: Um ex-presidiário sequestra a filha de um poderoso gângster. Ele não imagina que está entrando no caminho de um serial killer psicopata.

Em seu trajeto de consumo compulsivo e violência, ela atravessa um Nordeste em desenvolvimento e também apocalíptico. Quando passa a ser investigada pelos assassinatos de três homens, sua turnê se transforma em uma estratégia de fuga. De estrela ascendente, ela se torna uma heroína marginal, a temida Serial Kelly, a primeira mulher assassina em série do Brasil.

programme.desc: Uma sereia malvada se apaixona por Roman, noivo de Marina, e tenta mantê-lo longe dela em seu Reino da Morte debaixo d'água.
programme.title: A Sereia - Lago dos Mortos

programme.desc: Após o desmoronamento de uma mina de diamantes, Mike McCann, um experiente motorista de caminhão, é recrutado por Jim Goldenrod para liderar uma missão de resgate. Ele e sua equipe têm apenas 30 horas para transportar uma enorme carga sobre rios congelados e tentarem salvar a vida dos mineradores soterrados.

programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários sequestra uma luxuosa boda e não sabem que a dama de honra é uma agente secreta pronta para desatar o inferno sobre quem tentar arruinar o casamento.
programme.title: Duro de Casar

programme.desc: Marina, uma jovem mineira determinada a cursar Medicina no Rio de Janeiro após ser aprovada no vestibular, enfrenta a resistência dos pais superprotetores e uma série de imprevistos ao chegar em terras cariocas. Sua vida na cidade maravilhosa toma um rumo surpreendente quando conhece, em um encontro inesperado, João Mendes, grande astro do pagode.

programme.desc: Comandos das Forças Especiais são sequestrados em plena operação por uma nave espacial misteriosa e, ao despertar, tornam-se vítimas de uma raça alienígena implacável em uma luta pela sobrevivência.

programme.desc: Com um novo parceiro canino, um homem busca justiça depois que uma gangue ataca sua família.

programme.desc: Desde crianças, a advogada Liv e a professora infantil Emma são melhoras amigas. Elas planejam seus casamentos juntas e escolhem o mesmo local para a festa: o famoso Plaza Hotel, em Nova York. Mas, quando um erro de agendamento provoca um conflito de datas, Liv e Kate descobrem seus demônios interiores. Isso porque nenhuma das duas pretende ceder e mudar a data da cerimônia, passando, então, a sabotar as festividades da rival.
programme.title: Noivas em Guerra

programme.desc: Paula é uma adolescente que enfrenta todas as questões comuns de sua idade: o primeiro amor, os problemas na escola, as brigas com os pais. Mas sua família tem algo diferente: seus pais e seu irmão são surdos e é ela quem administra a fazenda e traduz a língua de sinais nas conversas com os vizinhos. Um dia, porém, ela descobre ter o talento para o canto e pode integrar uma escola prestigiosa em Paris. Agora, Paula precisa fazer uma escolha que a distanciará da família e a forçará a crescer.
programme.title: A Família Bélier

programme.desc: Menino que perdeu a mãe encontra um tigre enjaulado perto de sua casa. Com ajuda de sua amiga e uma camareira, eles fazem de tudo para salvá-lo em uma aventura cheia de imaginação.
programme.title: O Despertar do Tigre

programme.desc: Bela é uma jovem sensível e compreensiva, que sempre põe os outros em primeiro lugar. Quando seu pai se vê em uma situação complicada após contrair uma dívida e perder sua liberdade, ela não hesita em viver em um castelo ao lado de um ser horrível para poder salvá-lo. Também prisioneira, mas tratada como convidada na opulenta mansão, Bela começa a enxergar a beleza do caráter da misteriosa criatura e passa a sentir afeto por ele.
programme.title: A Bela e a Fera

programme.desc: Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor e John Deacon formam a banda de rock Queen em 1970. Quando o estilo de vida agitado de Mercury começa a sair de controle, o grupo precisa encontrar uma forma de lidar com o sucesso e os excessos de seu líder.
programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody

programme.desc: As donas de casa Alice e Celine são melhores amigas e vizinhas que parecem ter tudo. No entanto, quando um trágico acidente destrói a harmonia de suas vidas, a culpa, a suspeita e a paranoia começam a desfazer seu vínculo.
programme.title: Instinto Materno

programme.desc: Eva acabou de dar à luz ao seu terceiro filho e se depara com a angústia de uma depressão pós-parto em meio a uma vida supostamente perfeita. O ar tranquilo de sua família é invadido por acontecimentos estranhos quando suas filhas gêmeas aparecem machucadas. Eva é acusada pela comunidade. Isolada e questionada por seu próprio marido, ela precisa superar sua fragilidade para provar sua inocência e reestruturar sua família.
programme.title: Uma Família Feliz

programme.desc: Na década de 1940, na Carolina do Sul, o operário Noah Calhoun e a rica Allie se apaixonam desesperadamente, mas os pais da jovem não aprovam o namoro. Noah é enviado para lutar na Segunda Guerra Mundial, e parece ser o fim do romance. Enquanto isso, Allie se envolve com outro homem. No entanto, a paixão deles ainda não acabou quando Noah retorna para a pequena cidade anos mais tarde, próximo ao casamento de Allie.
programme.title: Diário de uma Paixão

programme.desc: Um homem vive atormentado após perder a sua filha mais nova, cujo corpo nunca foi encontrado, mas sinais de que ela teria sido violentada e assassinada são encontrados em uma cabana nas montanhas. Anos depois da tragédia, ele recebe um chamado misterioso para retornar a esse local, onde ele vai receber uma lição de vida.
programme.title: A Cabana

programme.desc: Um jovem delinquente do ensino médio é obrigado a ser o tutor de uma escola de baixa renda. Lá, ele se apaixona pela filha do pastor e vive uma paixão cheia de diferenças e surpresas.
programme.title: Um Amor para Recordar

programme.desc: Alice é uma adolescente trans cheia de carisma que investe seu tempo fazendo vídeos para o YouTube. Um dia, seu pai, Jean, é transferido pela empresa do Recife para Araucárias do Sul, e eles precisam se mudar. Na nova escola, Alice enfrenta preconceitos ao se deparar com uma sociedade mais retrógrada do que estava acostumada. O desejo da menina é dar seu primeiro beijo, mas, antes de tudo, quer o direito de ser quem ela é.
programme.title: Alice Júnior

programme.desc: As últimas 12 horas da vida de Jesus de Nazaré. No meio da noite, Jesus é traído por Judas e é preso por soldados no Monte das Oliveiras. Após ser severamente espancado pelos seus captores, Jesus é entregue para o governador romano na Judeia, Poncio Pilatos, pois só ele poderia ordenar a pena de morte. Jesus foi açoitado, coroado de espinhos e carregou a cruz até o local de execução, evento central de sacrifício e redenção na fé cristã.
programme.title: A Paixão de Cristo

programme.desc: Bridget Jones é uma solteirona de trinta e poucos anos que decide registrar em um diário suas tentativas de melhorar de vida. O resultado é um relato picante e bem-humorado de suas desventuras profissionais, familiares e românticas.
programme.title: O Diário de Bridget Jones

programme.desc: Cobrir a guerra do Afeganistão proporcionou alguns dos melhores relatos da carreira do jornalista Paul Asher, mas causou impactos profundos em sua vida. Atormentado pela falta de esperança e um casamento prestes a acabar, Paul se vê diante do maior desafio de sua vida profissional: uma entrevista com um homem misterioso que diz ser Deus.
programme.title: Entrevista com Deus

programme.desc: Um casal enfrenta os desafios da adolescência da filha e aposta em métodos educativos nada convencionais para restaurar a harmonia familiar.
programme.title: Queridos, Cresci!

programme.desc: Auggie Pullman é um garoto que nasceu com uma deformidade facial e precisou passar por 27 cirurgias plásticas. Aos 10 anos, ele começa finalmente a frequentar uma escola regular, como qualquer outra criança, pela primeira vez. No quinto ano, ele precisa se esforçar para conseguir se encaixar em sua nova realidade.
programme.title: Extraordinário

programme.desc: Noé vive com a esposa Naameh e os filhos Sem, Cam e Jafé em um mundo devastado pelo pecado, onde os homens perseguem e matam mutuamente. Um dia, Noé recebe uma missão divina: construir uma imensa arca para abrigar os animais durante um dilúvio.
programme.title: Noé

programme.desc: Em visita à cidade italiana de Verona com seu noivo ocupado, uma jovem chamada Sophie visita um muro onde os desiludidos deixam cartas para a trágica heroína de Shakespeare, Julieta Capuleto. Ao encontrar uma dessas cartas, de 1957, a jovem decide escrever à autora, Claire. Inspirada pela atitude de Sophie, Claire decide procurar por seu antigo amor.
programme.title: Cartas para Julieta

programme.desc: A vida problemática e a trajetória musical do cantor e compositor Tim Maia, da infância no Rio de Janeiro até a morte prematura, aos 55 anos.
programme.title: Tim Maia

programme.desc: Elizabeth Bennet vive com sua mãe, pai e irmãs no campo, na Inglaterra. Por ser uma das filhas mais velhas, ela enfrenta uma crescente pressão de seus pais para se casar. Quando Elizabeth é apresentada ao belo e rico Darcy, faíscas voam. Embora haja uma química óbvia entre os dois, a natureza excessivamente reservada de Darcy ameaça a relação.
programme.title: Orgulho e Preconceito

programme.desc: Laura precisa lidar com um câncer e um término de namoro. Ela vê seu mundo ficar ainda mais caótico quando encontra um charmoso monstro dentro de seu armário.
programme.title: Minha Fera

programme.desc: Um milionário tetraplégico contrata um homem da periferia para ser o seu acompanhante, apesar de sua aparente falta de preparo. No entanto, a relação que antes era profissional cresce e vira uma amizade que mudará a vida dos dois.
programme.title: Intocáveis

programme.desc: Tyler Gage é um rapaz problemático que tem que fazer trabalhos comunitários em uma escola de arte. Ele chama a atenção de Nora, uma talentosa bailarina que está tentando misturar passos de hip-hop ao balé clássico e que o convence a ajudá-la.
programme.title: Ela Dança, Eu Danço

programme.desc: De coração partido e à deriva, Lourenço, um imigrante brasileiro indocumentado, busca um propósito. Conforme a temporada de verão chega ao fim, ele inicia um romance intenso e inesperado com Maurice.
programme.title: Maré Alta

programme.desc: O casal Maria e Henry está aproveitando as férias de inverno na Tailândia com os três filhos pequenos. Mas em uma manhã, um tsunami de proporções devastadoras atinge o local, arrastando tudo o que encontra pela frente. Separados em dois grupos, a mãe e o filho mais velho vão enfrentar situações desesperadoras para se manterem vivos, enquanto o pai e as duas crianças menores não sabem se os outros dois continuam vivos.
programme.title: O Impossível

programme.desc: Naveen vem de uma família tradicional com ascendência indiana, mas está noivo de Jay, um homem branco. Agora, seu maior desafio é organizar com seus pais um clássico casamento indiano.
programme.title: Noivo à Indiana

programme.desc: Stella passa muito tempo no hospital devido a uma fibrose cística. Lá, ela conhece Will, que sofre da mesma doença. Eles são obrigados a manter distância, mas mesmo assim se apaixonam.
programme.title: A Cinco Passos de Você

programme.desc: Prestes a se casar em um megaevento na frente de milhares de pessoas, a superestrela Kat Valdez descobre que está sendo traída e decide se casar com um estranho da plateia, o simples professor Charlie. Apesar de não saber como sustentar esse casamento de fachada, os dois seguem em frente, mesmo vivendo em mundos opostos. Mas, aos poucos, um sentimento surge e os dois percebem o quanto precisam um do outro.
programme.title: Case Comigo

programme.desc: Paige Morgan é uma boa aluna que se apaixona por Eddie, aluno dinamarquês de intercâmbio. Ela descobre que ele é o herdeiro do trono da Dinamarca e entende que terá que superar alguns obstáculos para ficar com ele.
programme.title: Um Príncipe em Minha Vida

programme.desc: A estudante Bella Swan conhece Edward Cullen, um belo, mas misterioso adolescente. Edward é um vampiro, cuja família não bebe sangue, e Bella, longe de ficar assustada, se envolve em um romance perigoso com sua alma gêmea imortal.
programme.title: Crepúsculo

programme.desc: Depois da partida de Edward, Jacob se transforma no melhor amigo de Bella. Mas o que ela não imagina é que Jacob também tem um segredo que mudará suas vidas repentinamente.
programme.title: A Saga Crepúsculo - Lua Nova

programme.desc: Bella enfim está reunida a seu grande amor, Edward. Eles planejam se casar e efetuar a transformação dela em uma vampira. Só que a vida do grupo de vampiros está em perigo quando uma legião de novatos é levantada em Seattle.
programme.title: A Saga Crepúsculo - Eclipse

programme.desc: O casamento de Edward e Bella, sua lua de mel e o nascimento do filho desencadeiam uma série de acontecimentos que trará desdobramentos chocantes para Jacob.
programme.title: A Saga Crepúsculo: Amanhecer - Parte 1

programme.desc: Entertainment Matérias especiais sobre o mundo da sétima arte, o cinema.
programme.title: Preview

programme.desc: Depois do nascimento da filha de Bella e Edward, Renesmee, os Cullen reúnem lobisomens, clãs de vampiros e outros aliados de todo o mundo para protegê-la, já que uma falsa alegação faz com que os Volturi queiram matá-la.
programme.title: A Saga Crepúsculo: Amanhecer - Parte 2

programme.desc: Rafi, uma empresária divorciada de 37 anos, inicia um relacionamento com David, um artista de 23 anos. Enquanto sua terapeuta Lisa ajuda Rafi a aceitar a diferença de idade, descobre que David é seu filho. O dilema ético complica a relação do casal.
programme.title: Terapia do Amor

programme.desc: Malu é uma atriz desempregada que vive das memórias de seu passado glorioso e divide uma casa em uma favela do Rio de Janeiro com sua mãe conservadora. Ela também tem um relacionamento conturbado com sua filha.
programme.title: Malu

programme.desc: Tom é um imigrante brasileiro em busca do sonho americano e ele parece se tornar realidade quando encontra Josh, um escritor buscando uma nova história.
programme.title: América

programme.desc: César Catilina, um arquiteto idealista que quer construir a cidade dos sonhos, tem como grande rival o ganancioso prefeito Franklin Cicero, cuja filha Júlia se vê dividida entre a lealdade ao pai e o amor por César.
programme.title: Megalópolis

programme.desc: Professor universitário encontra na estação de trem um filhote de cachorro da raça Akita, conhecida por sua lealdade. O cão passa a acompanhá-lo até a estação de trem e esperar sua volta. Até que um acontecimento inesperado altera sua vida.
programme.title: Sempre ao Seu Lado

programme.desc: Na tentativa de alcançar a imortalidade, o rei Luis XIV captura uma sereia e rouba sua força vital, mas uma descoberta feita por sua filha ilegítima ameaça os planos do rei.
programme.title: A Filha do Rei

programme.desc: Homem recusa toda a ajuda de sua filha à medida que envelhece. Ele começa a duvidar dos entes queridos, de sua própria mente e de sua realidade ao tentar compreender as mudanças que estão acontecendo em sua vida.
programme.title: Meu Pai

programme.desc: Quando o time feminino é extinto, a talentosa jogadora Viola se disfarça como seu irmão gêmeo para continuar jogando em outra escola. O plano funciona até que sentimentos inesperados surgem entre ela e os amigos do irmão, complicando seu disfarce.
programme.title: Ela É o Cara

programme.desc: Recuperando-se de uma separação difícil, uma mulher se vê envolvida em um triângulo amoroso com dois homens que são melhores amigos, mas totalmente opostos.
programme.title: Amor a Três

programme.desc: Uma família negra da periferia de Contagem, Minas Gerais, busca seguir seus sonhos em um país que acaba de eleger como presidente um homem de extrema-direita, que representa o contrário de tudo que eles são.
programme.title: Marte Um

programme.desc: Jesus vive com sua família em Alexandria, onde eles fugiram do massacre de crianças. Com a morte do Rei eles voltam para Nazaré, sem saber que o herdeiro é como o pai e está determinado a matar Jesus.
programme.title: O Jovem Messias

programme.desc: Acompanhe a vida do garoto Mason durante um período de doze anos, da infância à juventude, analisando seu relacionamento com os pais, suas descobertas, experiências e seus conflitos.
programme.title: Boyhood - Da Infância à Juventude

programme.desc: Dois amigos de infância estão em busca do amor de suas vidas. Enquanto Christian se passa por judeu para conquistar a bela Alison, Adam quer sair com todas. A dupla então começa a se ajudar para que ambos possam se dar bem.
programme.title: Procura-se a Mulher Perfeita

programme.desc: Um documentário sobre o maior piloto brasileiro de Fórmula 1, Ayrton Senna, que ganhou o campeonato mundial três vezes antes de morrer tragicamente aos 34 anos.
programme.title: Senna

programme.desc: Durante a recessão nos Estados Unidos, um homem de negócios falido viaja para a Arábia Saudita para vender uma ideia a um monarca que está construindo um enorme complexo no meio do deserto.

programme.title: A Filha do Rei

programme.desc: Benjamin Button é um homem que nasce idoso e rejuvenesce à medida que o tempo passa. Doze anos depois de seu nascimento, ele conhece Daisy, uma criança que entra e sai de sua vida enquanto cresce para ser dançarina. Embora tenha todos os tipos de aventuras incomuns, sua relação com Daisy o faz acreditar que os dois se encontrarão no momento certo da vida.
programme.title: O Curioso Caso de Benjamin Button

programme.desc: Nando trabalha como entregador em uma lanchonete de Copacabana e sonha em ser uma estrela do trap, mas não tem muitas oportunidades. Até que ele conhece Jaque, uma moça acostumada desde cedo a se virar para sobreviver - nem sempre da forma mais convencional. Jaque acredita no potencial de Nando e decide, à sua maneira, lançá-lo como artista.
programme.title: Confia - Sonho de Cria

programme.desc: S4 E16 — Falha no Teste Após seu teste de gravidez dar negativo, Monique não acredita quando dá à luz em seu banheiro. Com medo de a ambulância demorar demais, ela mesma leva o recém-nascido para o hospital.
programme.title: Eu Não Sabia que Estava Grávida

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Uma Noiva, Muitas Opiniões Jordan vai se casar com o namorado de infância e decide trazer sua mãe, irmã e tia à loja para ajudá-la a escolher o vestido perfeito para um casamento no inverno.
programme.title: O Vestido Ideal - Reino Unido

programme.desc: S7 E2 — Bronca Necessária Buddy faz um bolo em formato de caminhão de lixo; um bolo especial para a fundadora de uma equipe de nado sincronizado; Buddy tem que intervir quando Mary é acusada de ser rude com a equipe de trabalho.
programme.title: Cake Boss

programme.desc: S7 E3 — Surpresa Buddy tem uma inspiração divina quando o padre Bob encomenda um bolo para homenagear um membro da igreja; em seu aniversário de 50 anos, a equipe prepara uma festa surpresa para Danny com alguns convidados especiais.
programme.title: Cake Boss

programme.desc: S13 E8 — Decote Profundo As medidas avantajadas de Danielle estouram seu orçamento. Stephanie quer mostrar seus atributos, para desgosto da mãe. Christie perdeu peso e espera que o vestido que comprou ainda destaque o busto.
programme.title: O Vestido Ideal

programme.desc: S13 E3 — Conselhos de Astro No ateliê Kleinfeld, Mike Sorrentino ajuda sua irmã mais nova, Melissa, a encontrar um vestido de noiva. Já Ashley rouba a cena com seu vestido de flores de Pnina, feito sob encomenda.
programme.title: O Vestido Ideal

programme.desc: S1 E39 — Vestida pelo Comitê Nicola sonha com um vestido atemporal, mas sua mãe e avó querem que ela use um de seus vestidos.
programme.title: O Vestido Ideal - Reino Unido

programme.desc: S1 E40 — Sobrecarga de Acompanhantes Kara preza a opinião da avó, mas fica em dúvida sobre o vestido que ela escolheu; Yasmin se apaixona por um vestido, mas sua mãe, nem tanto.
programme.title: O Vestido Ideal - Reino Unido

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Preso em um Triângulo Amoroso Cigano Uma futura noiva se vê em um triângulo amoroso com dois pretendentes em potencial e uma madrinha infernal; uma adolescente larga a tradição para se tornar a primeira supermodelo cigana.
programme.title: Meu Grande Casamento Cigano

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Vodu Depois de sair à noite em Nova Orleans, as garotas passeiam pela cidade e visitam uma loja de produtos de vodu. Mas quando Mellie e Annie decidem ir mais cedo para os bares, os ânimos se exaltam.
programme.title: Irmãs Ciganas

programme.desc: Peter Parker está em uma viagem de duas semanas pela Europa, ao lado de seus amigos de colégio, quando é surpreendido pela visita de Nick Fury. Criminosos assassinam Susan Plummer, a melhor amiga de Robert McCall e sua ex-colega de trabalho. Obcecado, Robert pensa apenas em eliminar o bando de assassinos profissionais que destruiu sua vida.

programme.desc: Trinta anos depois da guerra ter dizimado o mundo, um guerreiro solitário chamado Eli caminha por horizontes arruinados dando esperança aos que restaram. Apenas outro homem compreende o poder de um livro que Eli carrega e está determinado a se apoderar dele. Apesar de Eli preferir a paz, ele arriscará a sua vida para proteger a sua carga preciosa, pois precisa cumprir o seu destino de ajudar a restaurar a humanidade.

programme.desc: Eddie Brock e seu simbionte alienígena estabeleceram algumas regras básicas. Embora Venom preferisse passar todo o seu tempo devorando vilões, Eddie está agora determinado a retomar sua carreira no jornalismo. O assassino em série Cletus Kasady - que deseja falar com Eddie sobre suas vítimas - surge exatamente no momento certo. Quando Kasady se transforma no brutal Carnificina durante sua execução e semeia o caos, Venom é forçado a intervir.
programme.title: Venom - Tempo de Carnificina

programme.desc: S2 E23 — Squab, Squab, Squab, Squab, Squab Alan hesita em deixar Jake passar a noite com Evelyn até que se vê festejando com Charlie e um time de belas jogadoras de vôlei.
programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.desc: S2 E24 — Does This Smell Funny to You? Charlie dorme com uma mulher linda e jovem, sem perceber que ela é casada com um homem idoso. Na escola, Jake lê uma redação para sua classe sobre o seu fim de semana, e recorda um velho entrando na sua casa à procura de sua esposa.
programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.desc: S3 E1 — Weekend in Bangkok With Two Olympic Gymnasts Depois de Alan cair do telhado tentando consertar a antena, Charlie se voluntaria para cuidar de Jake no fim de semana. Enquanto isso, Evelyn insiste em arranjar um encontro às cegas para Alan.
programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Principal Gallagher's Lesbian Lover Jake é suspenso da escola após fazer um desenho ofensivo de uma colega. Alan é chamado pelo diretor da escola para conversar sobre o ocorrido. Enquanto isso, Charlie tem de tomar conta do garoto.
programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.desc: S3 E3 — Carpet Burns and a Bite Mark Charlie descobre que Alan teve um caso recente com ex-esposa, Judith. Charlie faz tudo em seu poder - inclusive tenta distrair Alan com mulheres bonitas para manter os dois separados.
programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.desc: S2 E9 — And the New Boss Max não sabe como deve agir no papel de chefe quando ela e Caroline contratam uma estagiária para ajudá-las a abrir a loja de cupcakes.
programme.title: 2 Broke Girls

programme.desc: S8 E4 — Paixão Mortal A família de um homem é massacrada na Virgínia Ocidental. O filho mais velho, Gavin Smith, de 16 anos, é encontrado na casa da namorada. A polícia logo descobre que o crime foi cometido pelos dois adolescentes.
programme.title: Sinais de um Psicopata

programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.title: DNA Criminoso

programme.title: Emboscada

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Siga a Trilha Um rapper é morto perto de um restaurante de Nova Orleans e a polícia usa tecnologia de ponta para encontrar o culpado. Uma série de roubos em Jonesboro, Arkansas, confunde a polícia.
programme.title: Crime em Tempo Real

programme.desc: S2 E9 — Irreconhecível Um assassinato é filmado por câmeras e a polícia em Enid, Oklahoma, usa a tecnologia para capturar um trio de assassinos; em Dubuque, Iowa, os investigadores usam vídeos para achar o assassino de uma mulher.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: This season 400 hundred girls that have dared to dream they can become a world-famous Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader, put it all on the line, as preliminary auditions for the 2015-2016 season begin.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Talent and looks alone won't get you on the squad. Dreams are made and hopes are crushed as only 46 out of 59 candidates make it into Training Camp.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: As Training Camp starts Kelli lays down the law. Girls start to crack as the reality of how hard it is to become a DCC sets in. Melissa Rycroft offers hope and advice on how to make it through.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Kelli and Judy must cut 10 girls to get to the magic number of 36 for the squad. Uniform Fittings gives Kelli a better idea of who has the whole package. As the cuts begin so does emotional end of dreams.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: As the girls get the DCC look, it helps some and not others. Two surprise guests stop by rehearsal and rock the DCC's world. Kelli has one of the most awkward office visits of all time.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Cameos and Show Group auditions push the new girls and vets to their limits. Melissa Rycroft tries to save a DCC that's hanging by a thread and there is a shocking outcome from a Kelli office visit.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Emotions are supercharged as Kelli & Judy make a lot of tough cuts to keep up the quality of the team. Melissa Rycroft offers invaluable field experience.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Kelli finally announces the squad. Injuries threaten the opening of Cowboys training camp. Game Day chaos endangers a flawless performance.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Hundreds of beautiful and talented hopefuls arrive to try out for the best cheerleading team in the world, while many of the returning girls are looking for redemption. New judges increase the pressure of moving on to Finals.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Veterans fight for their jobs as new girls try to live their dreams and make DCC Training Camp. Standing in their way is; panel Interviews, solos, an exhausting dance combination and a room full of very tough judges.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The new candidates' eyes are opened as they get a taste of what it is to be a DCC. As girls struggle to learn the dances, the reality of being "Big Time", sets in. Melissa Rycroft meets the new girls for the first time.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: With the first cut looming, the girls must push their dance skills to the limit. Melissa Rycroft works to bring out showmanship. Extra stress is added on Makeover day as the girls try to get the DCC look.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: A new choreographer shakes things up. The girls better start looking good because uniform fittings and the Belk fashion show are on the agenda. Surprises continue when two-time Grammy winner Kacey Musgraves, stops by rehearsal.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Melissa Rycroft makes a house call to help Yuko. Kitty Carter rocks a few of the candidate's worlds. Cameos give Kelli & Judy a fresh perspective on the girls. At Show Group auditions, the girls let it all hang out.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Kellie Pickler comes to a rehearsal to share her experience and motivate the girls as Training Camp is coming to an end. Melissa Rycroft makes Kelsey aware of a big mistake. Candace Romo helps with a big night of cuts.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Squad announcement is bittersweet as some favorites go home. The team has their first appearance at the Star Ribbon cutting. Game Day is when dreams come true!

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: Hundreds of beautiful and talented women converge on AT&T Stadium to start the hardest audition process in professional sports, trying out for a coveted spot on the most famous NFL cheerleading squad in the world, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: With the field narrowed down to 119 women, the pressure is on. They must quickly learn a power pom routine and the famous kickline in order to perform it an hour later before the judges.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: The veterans finally enter the audition process. Now all 83 women are judged head to head during a panel interview, a solo dance performance and on their appearance on the football field as seen and the big screen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: 44 women begin the very first training camp at the new 1 billion dollar Cowboys' facility, The Star. At the First Meeting, Kelli lays down the law and makes it clear that eight women will be sent home this summer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: First, the ladies need to have the "classic look" of a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader. Kelli's hair and make-up transformations are legendary. The ladies are also assessed through a new state of the art fitness test, "Styku".

programme.desc: After heading out to a mountain cabin, Jesse goes missing, only to turn up five days later in Utah, claiming to have been abducted by aliens.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Novelist Kay Ludlow is dealing with writer's block while her literary agent Jim Rothman pressures her to turn out 350 pages by the following day to secure his two million dollar share.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Amanda cruises into cyberspace during a spell of boredom and randomly enters the website "Welcome to Joanne's living room" for mindless entertainment.

programme.desc: Steve joins his troubled partner, Reggie Ackroyd, in a rehab facility for stressed-out cops. Reggie seems delusional and keeps blaming a murderer he caught for abducting his wife and daughter, and Steve encourages him.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: It's a busy day for the homicide unit and Community General when three murders take place. Further investigation reveals that none of the suspects knew their victims, and they are all terminal patients at Community General.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Jesse and Susan are on their way to Mount Carmel for a romantic getaway weekend but detour to a fishing town when their car breaks down. They grab a bite at the local diner when Susan sees a man she used to know.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: When resident Paul Brewer is killed, it's the second murder in a month at the exclusive gated community, Hillview Estates. With no leads on the killer, Steve goes undercover as Dr. Steve Brewer, a community resident.

programme.desc: Parker Williams is shocked to find his ex-fiancée, Beverly Ross, at a drug deal, but he’s even more shocked when Beverly accuses him of using excessive force during the arrest. He claims it was self-defense, but Beverly is sticking to her story.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Former madam, Maybelle Cheseboro, has returned to Sparta, but this time with a legitimate phone sex business, instead of a brothel. Meanwhile, a city official, Drew Ward, is linked to the death of Jessica Lund, one of Maybelle’s phone workers.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Chief Forbes starts a boxing program in Sparta to help young men at risk and has taken a special interest in one kid with a lot of promise, Kevin Brooks; however, Forbes soon discovers that Kevin is involved in a series of burglaries in town.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Lieutenant Lonnie Jamison’s wealthy aunt, Cordelia Woodlin, is back in Sparta and spending time with her very old and dear friend, blues singer Ches Collins; that is until Ches starts receiving racist death threats warning him to stay away from her.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Soon after Virgil Tibbs is hired by a local law firm, a pair of wealthy clients, the Bookers, are in a car accident; Chuck Booker survives, but Abby is killed. Chuck claims he was dodging a deer, but Tibbs suspects that Abby’s death was no accident.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: A new synagogue in Sparta is plagued by vandalism, but when the temple is destroyed and the sacred Torah is stolen, Rabbi Feldman refuses Sheriff Gillespie’s help based on a decades-old anti-Semitic crime that Gillespie apparently helped cover up.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night

programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new friend!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith's Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith's battle strategy to metalize his Red-Eyes Black Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other's strategies and cards.
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him. It's the very same card Yugi gave Joey as a sign of friendship!
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba, and Mokuba on the line.
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi's monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi's soul into a card, just like Kaiba?
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus's mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus's Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi crumples under the power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi's chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Pegasus summons Relinquished, a fearsome monster that can consume Yugi's Duel Monsters! Yugi counters with… Kuriboh?
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 5

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi's mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole the Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend the Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it's not the power of the cards, but the heart that's in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of Kaiba Corporation trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game. Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can YUGI and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends rescue Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game! The only exit is past a Five-Headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba, and Mailose all their life points!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Duke Devlin defeats Joey and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey's freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi's position is helpless!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Duke's all-powerful Orogoth The Relentless dices Yugi's entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze. Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed. Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's recent exploits make their way around the world! The reputation of this mighty pirate begins to grow as all eyes look towards the Straw Hats' next move! Also - German 66 leaves an artifact behind which excites the crew!
programme.sub-title: The World is Stunned! The Fifth Emperor of the Sea Emerges!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don't fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy's exploits and remembers their shared past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!
programme.sub-title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague.
programme.sub-title: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Stelly, Sabo's adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve.
programme.sub-title: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.
programme.sub-title: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca's Sentiments!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.
programme.sub-title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon.
programme.sub-title: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!

programme.desc: After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!
programme.sub-title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Teen Killers
programme.desc: They were too young to drink or vote but they were not too young to commit the most brutal of crimes. Some were driven by pure curiosity: how would it feel to take a life?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sanity.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then, without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970's and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: Alien Files Unsealed
programme.desc: Countdown To Disclosure: Evidence suggests the world's governments could be on the verge of announcing everything they know about UFOs. What will this mean for our society?

programme.title: Alien Files Unsealed
programme.desc: It’s the stuff of nightmares. Emergency lines are flooded with calls as UFOs appear in the sky faster than authorities can track them.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: Stargate Portals
programme.desc: Discover doorways to wormholes in time, their secret locations around the world, as well as who is trying to open them and why.

programme.title: Conspiracy Files Unsealed: New World Order
programme.desc: An elite group of power-brokers may be trying to rule the planet.

programme.title: Dynasty: Tale of the Tape
programme.desc: Sable unleashes her lawsuit against Alexis; Dex dives into the hidden vault beneath the lake and finds it empty; Zorelli tracks down the uncle of Dominique Devereaux, learning he knows something about Grimes' murder; Alexis leaves for Switzerland.

programme.title: Dynasty: No Bones About It
programme.desc: Blake is a suspect in Elsworth Chisolm's apparent murder; Zorelli is put back on the Grimes case; Charles Matthews warns Blake that Zorelli has been asking him questions about Blake's father.

programme.title: Dynasty: Here Comes the Son
programme.desc: Jeff and Dex meet with Roger Grimes' wife and learn he has a son; Sable is pregnant and unable to tell Dex that he is the father; Adam has a picture of Jeff and Monica retouched to appear incestuous and then submits it to a sleazy tabloid.

programme.title: Dynasty: Blast from the Past
programme.desc: Charles Matthews tells Blake a grim secret; Zorelli finds a bug hidden in his apartment; Alexis tells Monica that Jason Colby isn't her father; Alexis learns she has a Fredrick Stahl original and realizes Blake's deep, dark secret.

programme.title: Dynasty: Cache 22
programme.desc: Alexis threatens to sue Blake for half of the plundered Nazzi treasure unless Sable withdraws her lawsuits against Colbyco. Sable agrees; Krystina leads Fallon to the treasure. They are followed by Dennis Grimes.

programme.title: Dynasty: Oil, Pt. 1
programme.desc: As Krystle Grant Jennings prepares to marry wealthy oil tycoon Blake Carrington, Matthew Blaisdel, a former lover, returns to town and causes her second thoughts.

programme.title: Dynasty: Oil, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Blake's estranged son Steven returns home for the ceremony, as does rebellious daughter Fallon, who objects to the union. Blake and Krystle reconcile; Matthew is reunited with his wife and daughter; Walter's rig is sabotaged

programme.title: Dynasty: Oil, Pt. 3
programme.desc: Blake and Krystle are married; Jeff Colby pursues a disinterested Fallon; Walter and Matthew form a business partnership; Claudia and Lindsay try without success to resolve their differences.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Honeymoon
programme.desc: Urgent business cuts short Blake and Krystle's honeymoon; Steven takes a job working for Matthew Blaisdel; Cecil proposes that Fallon marry his nephew.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Dinner Party
programme.desc: Blake invites Matthew to dinner at the mansion to entice him to return to Denver-Carrington; Krystle clashes with head butler, Joseph; Matthew tells Krystle he's still in love with her; Jeff attempts to win Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty: Fallon's Wedding
programme.desc: Steven's ex-lover, Ted, arrives from New York; Fallon reluctantly marries Jeff Colby; Blake hires Michael, the chauffeur, to do undercover work for Denver-Carrington.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Chauffeur Tells a Secret
programme.desc: Steven is taunted on the job for being gay; Blake learns of the terms of Fallon's marriage to Jeff; Steven finds himself attracted to Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Bordello
programme.desc: Walter takes Steven to a bordello; Steven is blamed for sabotaging Matthew's rig; Krystle pawns her diamonds to help Matthew financially.

programme.title: Dynasty: Krystle's Lie
programme.desc: After being fired for sabotaging Matthew's equipment, an innocent Steven learns he was set up; Lindsay is shattered to learn about her birth; Blake tries to learn who bankrolled Matthew; Fallon warns Steven's ex-lover to stay away from her brother.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Necklace
programme.desc: Matthew and Walter's well comes in; Fallon asks to borrow the necklace Krystle pawned to help Matthew; at his mountain cabin, Steven and Claudia make love.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Beating
programme.desc: Steven announces he is moving out of the mansion; the chauffeur, Michael, tells Blake of Steven's affair with Claudia; Fallon resumes relations with Michael, until Blake has the chauffeur worked over; Lindsay sees her mother with Steven.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: Blake learns Krystle pawned her emerald necklace to help out Matthew; Fallon tells Jeff she married him solely for her father's welfare; Steven's former lover, Ted, arrives in Denver.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Separation
programme.desc: Steven tells Claudia he spent the night with Ted; Krystle leaves Blake; seeing Ted embrace his son, Blake strikes him; Steven accuses his father of murder.

programme.title: Arthur: Cents-less/Buster the Lounge Lizard
programme.desc: Mr. Ratburn decides it's time for his class to learn a little about money. For the entire weekend, no one in the class can spend a cent. Buster has the brand-new Dark Bunny Dark Buggy, complete with grappling hook and voice commands!

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. on Ice/Spoiled Rotten!
programme.desc: D.W. tells her friends that she's a fantastic skater, but she can barely stand on ice! With a skating party coming up, how will she face everyone and tell them the truth? Accused of being spoiled, Muffy sets out to prove her friends wrong.

programme.title: Arthur: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever
programme.desc: Arthur thinks his jokes about Sue Ellen's new sweater are in good fun but Sue Ellen's feelings are hurt. Has Arthur become a bully? Everyone is reminiscing about their "best days." Except Arthurs. Is it possible he doesn't have one?
programme.sub-title: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever

programme.title: The Rhythm and Roots of Arthur
programme.desc: Pack your bags, buckle your seatbelts, and get ready for an ARTHUR road trip to the family farm! Arthur’s Great-Grand Uncle Theo is celebrating his 85th birthday, so the Reads (and Buster) are off to Ohio to join in the festivities.

programme.title: Arthur: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal
programme.desc: It’s Lakewood Elementary Parents Open House! How will the kids survive a whole evening of their parents' embarrassing antics? Buster is the only kid in Elwood City who doesn't have a Cybertoy, so he decides to 'borrow' one from the store.
programme.sub-title: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal

programme.title: Arthur: Around the World in 11 Minutes/Muffy and the Big Bad Blog
programme.desc: Pal, Baby Kate, Amigo, and Mei Lin enthusiastically accept Nemo's dare to travel around the world and make it back in 11 minutes. Then, Muffy discovers that web blogging is a great way to keep her readers up to date with her every move.
programme.sub-title: Around the World in 11 Minutes/Muffy and the Big Bad Blog

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team
programme.desc: In D.W.’s heart lurks one big, gnawing desire--TO GET RID OF THOSE TRAINING WHEELS! Then, can Coach Frensky work with a baseball team where everyone is fighting about who gets to be pitcher and no one wants to practice?
programme.sub-title: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team

programme.title: Arthur: Caught in the Crosswires/Framed
programme.desc: Muffy is thrilled when mega producer J3 chooses her family for his latest reality TV project. After all, she was born to be star! Buster has just won the best young artist award at the Elwood City Arts Festival.

programme.title: Arthur: Based on a True Story (Part 1 & 2)
programme.desc: There's a new kid in town: Ladonna Compson, the Louisiana native with the gift of gab. Ladonna charms Arthur and friends with her amazing "true" stories. But are her stories really fact…or fiction?

programme.title: Arthur: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner
programme.desc: A blizzard comes to town, taking out the electricity and sending residents scrambling for supplies. Can neighbors find ways to help each other survive through the storm? Then, the unthinkable is happening...Arthur's teacher is moving in!
programme.sub-title: The Blizzard/The Rat Who Came To Dinner

programme.title: Arthur: The Pageant Pickle/Some Assembly Required
programme.desc: School is almost out and Arthur can hardly wait for those lazy summer days by Muffy's pool. Nothing could ruin such a happy time of year, except maybe D.W.'s Spring Pageant! And then D.W. can't wait to test out her new play set!

programme.title: Arthur: Bud's Knotty Problem/That’s MY Grandma!
programme.desc: When Bud falls in love with a snazzy new pair of boots, he might face his toughest adventure yet - learning to tie his shoes. D.W. gets jealous when Grandma Thora becomes the most popular babysitter in town.

programme.title: Arthur: D.W.'s Blankie/Arthur's Substitute Teacher Trouble
programme.desc: D.W. has one little secret--her blankie. When it mysteriously disappears, Arthur is pressed into service. Find that blankie--or else! Next, the unbelievable has happened--Mr. Ratburn has gotten sick. And who's going to be the substitute?

programme.title: Arthur: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos
programme.desc: Buster is convinced that he's seen real UFO's, and he uses Muffy's fancy new telescope to get the proof. Then, Mr. Sipple from next door is moving away and Arthur wonders--who will be the new neighbors?
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos

programme.title: Arthur: Buster Isn't Buying It/One Ornery Critter
programme.desc: Aliens, conspiracy theories, the megatoad--Buster believes in everything, until his favorite show gets cancelled for false reporting. Dogs love Arthur! Well, except Carrot Cake. Can Arthur win over this picky pup?
programme.sub-title: Buster Isn't Buying It/One Ornery Critter

programme.title: Arthur: To Eat or Not to Eat/S.W.E.A.T.
programme.desc: A brand-new candy bar is in town! And what exactly is this ingredient called Tri-Enzomated Zorn Jelly, anyway? Then, it's time for the kids at Lakewood Elementary to take the "S.W.E.A.T” test and anxiety is running high.
programme.sub-title: To Eat or Not to Eat/S.W.E.A.T.

programme.title: Arthur: No Acting Please/Prunella Deegan and the Disappointing Ending
programme.desc: When Fern lands a role in a community production, she fears she's not talented enough to be a star. Finally, the final volume of the Henry Screever series is out. Prunella and Marina compete to see who can finish the book the fastest.
programme.sub-title: No Acting Please/Prunella Deegan and the Disappointing Ending

programme.title: Arthur: Citizen Frensky/D.W.'S Backpack Mishap
programme.desc: After visiting The Elwood City Times, Francine decides to start her own paper--The Frensky Star! The tabloid is a success--until all her friends stop speaking to her. Somebody stole D.W.'s backpack!! Who is this fluffy unicorn thief?

programme.title: Arthur: Tales of Grotesquely Grim Bunny/Pet Projects
programme.desc: When the comic book store changes owners, the new darker comics are right up Fern's alley, but Arthur can't seem to stomach them. Arthur and Francine enter their pets to compete against each other in the "Perfect Pet" video contest.
programme.sub-title: Tales of Grotesquely Grim Bunny/Pet Projects

programme.title: Arthur: I'm A Poet/The Scare-Your-Pants-Off Club
programme.desc: Challenged by Fern to enter a poetry contest, Arthur and his friends each write a poem to be judged by the famous poet Jack Prelutsky. Then, Arthur and his friends develop a consuming passion for the Scare-Your-Pants-Off books.

programme.title: Arthur: Follow the Bouncing Ball/Buster Baxter and the Letter from the Sea
programme.desc: Alberto Molina's beloved soccer ball--signed by his favorite Ecuadorian soccer star --is lost! While on vacation, Buster discovers a message in a bottle on the shore. Could it be a message from the people of the lost city of Atlantis?
programme.sub-title: Follow the Bouncing Ball/Buster Baxter and the Letter from the Sea

programme.title: Arthur: Show Off/Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: It's the Elwood City dog show and Killer is facing off against Sebastian Winkleplotz, the snooty, championship-winning poodle. Arthur agrees to watch Amigo while Alberto's off at camp, but Pal gets worried.

programme.title: Arthur: Mr. Ratburn's Secret Identity/Besties
programme.desc: Mysterious calls. Superhuman strength. Is Mr. Ratburn secretly a superhero? When Buster and Ladonna bond over a memorable trip to the movies, Arthur feels left out. Has Ladonna taken his place as Buster's best bud?

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. Goes To Washington/Arthur's Mystery Envelope
programme.desc: D.W.'s on her way to Washington and she's bored by it all until she gets lost during a tour of the White House. Then, when Mr. Haney gives Arthur a sealed envelope to bring home to Mom, Arthur fears the worst.
programme.sub-title: D.W. Goes To Washington/Arthur's Mystery Envelope

programme.title: Arthur: D.W. All Wet/Buster's Dino Dilemma
programme.desc: The Reads are having a wonderful time at the beach, except for D.W. who simply refuses to have fun. Next, Buster and Arthur make a long-awaited field trip to a dinosaur excavation.

programme.title: Arthur: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party
programme.desc: Arthur and D.W. are planning a surprise party for Grandma Thora. But amidst the party-planning mayhem, they forget about the guest of honor! Then, shy Fern hosts a slumber party at her mother's urging.
programme.sub-title: Grandma Thora Appreciation Day/Fern's Slumber Party

programme.title: Arthur: Making Conversation/A Cloudy Day
programme.desc: Talking to adults makes George want to hide! When he learns he must go to a grown-up party, he turns to his friends for help. Then, Arthur and his friends learn that old silent films can be just as much fun as the movies they’re used to.

programme.title: Arthur: Pick a Car, Any Car/Jenna's Bedtime Blues
programme.desc: The family car is broken, and so is Arthur's heart. How can Mom and Dad even think of replacing it? It’s Muffy's annual slumber party, and Jenna is finally invited! But what if the other girls discover that she's an occasional bed-wetter?
programme.sub-title: Pick a Car, Any Car/Jenna's Bedtime Blues

programme.title: Arthur: Buster's Back/The Ballad Of Buster Baxter
programme.desc: Buster's coming home! The word spreads fast, but so does the fear that Buster will be different. Then, it seems to Buster, not only have his friends changed while he was gone, but they've forgotten all about him! Will he ever fit in again?
programme.sub-title: Buster's Back/The Ballad Of Buster Baxter

programme.title: Arthur: The Last Day (Part 1 & 2)
programme.desc: It's a time of change at Lakewood Elementary as Arthur and Buster move up to 4th grade. D.W. and Bud prepare to enter kindergarten and Muffy and Francine contemplate how spending the summer away from each other will affect their friendship.

programme.title: Arthur: Bully for Binky/Misfortune Teller
programme.desc: Is Binky Barnes really the most disgusting, nasty, horrible person on the planet, or is he just misunderstood? Next, what's got four sides and the answer to everything? Prunella's cootie catcher!

programme.title: Arthur: All About D.W./Blockheads
programme.desc: When Emily gets the starring role in the preschool play, D.W. is beside herself with jealousy. She should be Little Red Riding Hood, not Tree #2! Then, D.W. and Emily are upset when they get stuck with the blocks at playtime.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Battle of Anzio
programme.desc: Allied armies encounter German resistance in the Italian fishing town of Anzio.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Kwajalein
programme.desc: Examining the battle at the Kwajelein Atoll in the South Pacific during 1944. Included: operations by the Seabees.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Battle in Palau (Summer 1944)
programme.desc: As the United States prepared for the invasion of the Philippines, scheduled for late 1944, the tiny Palau Islands had to be taken first.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: D-Day (June 6,1944)
programme.desc: D-Day, the 6th of June--one of the most pivotal moments in world history. In a massive armada of thousands of ships, 3,000,000 allied troops land at Three Beaches in Normandy, France.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Retaking France
programme.desc: Six weeks after the D-Day invasion of the Beaches of Normandy, the allied forces are pushing the Germans back through the French countryside. Town by town is won back as Panzer divisions retreat back to the Meuse River.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Operation Dragoon (August 1944)
programme.desc: The Allies break into France and push the Germans back to their own border.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Liberation of the Paris
programme.desc: Both political and military expediency were factors in the return of the French capital to its people.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Arnhem
programme.desc: The Allies launch an attack designed to push the Germans back to the Rhine River.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY
programme.desc: Gen. Douglas MacArthur's return to the Philippines, and the final push to retake the islands after two years of Japanese occupation.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: The Last Stronghold (November 1944)
programme.desc: American B-29 high-altitude bomber attacks Japan near the end of World War II.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Mount Belvedere
programme.desc: The Battle of the Gothic Line in 1944.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Battle of the Bulge (December 1944)
programme.desc: The December 1944 battle pitting American forces against German Panzer divisions in the Ardennes Forest.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Mount Hot Rocks (February 19, 1945)
programme.desc: American forces landing on the shores of Iwo Jima encounter Japanese combatants willing to fight to the death.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Battle of Remagen
programme.desc: German forces retreat across the Rhine on the Remagen bridge near the close of the war.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Battle of Okinawa
programme.desc: Kamikaze pilots guard the island of Okinawa from American forces.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Fall of Berlin
programme.desc: In 1945, Soviet and American troops press Hitler's armies from the west and the east, culminating in the fall of Berlin.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Commerce Raiders
programme.desc: Heavily armed vessels disguised as ordinary cargo ships patrolled allied waters, sinking supply boats and stealing their content.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Bombing of Germany
programme.desc: The development of the B-17 bomber, which allowed American planes to reach inside Germany and bomb its cities.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: U-Boat War
programme.desc: U-boats posed the deadliest threat to Allied convoys traveling the Atlantic.

programme.title: Battle for the Bulge
programme.desc: The Battle for the Bulge was the last major German offensive move on the Western Front during the Second World War.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: To commemorate the 70th Anniversary of the Battle of Britain Ewan and Colin McGregor take to the skies to discover how; against the odds, the RAF inflicted Hitler's first defeat of WW2.

programme.title: Battle of Britain - Empty Skies
programme.desc: Tells the story of 19 men and women who were there. Through a series of filmed interviews their stories have been preserved, allowing them to tell the part they played in the nation's defence in their own words creating a unique collection of accounts.

programme.title: Battle of Britain: The Race For Radar
programme.desc: On the brink of war the Germans mount a daring Zeppelin spy mission. Had the Luftwaffe spies discovered Britain’s greatest secret?'

programme.title: Blitz the Aftermath
programme.desc: With interviews and archive footage showing the sheer amount of devastation – from the loss of life to the immense damage caused to buildings across the country - The Aftermath looks at how the Blitz changed the face of Britain's cities and lives.

programme.title: Boy Soldiers Of World War II
programme.desc: In Britain during World War Two, thousands of men over the age of 18 were conscripted into the army, but among them were hundreds of underage boys, some as young as 15, who lied about their age so that they could join up.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender - The Last 100 Days: Breakthrough in the East
programme.desc: 28th January 1945: The total war, propagated by Goebbels, strikes back at the Fatherland in all its drama and reaches its climax on German soil.

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show

programme.title: Catfish: The TV Show
