programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Bungalow
programme.desc: Mark blir siktet for drap og brannstiftelse. Alexis forteller Blake og politiet at han ville hevne seg. De andre mistenkte i saken, McVane, Hess og Adam, blir avhørt og løslatt.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Note
programme.desc: Alexis får en beskjed fra avdøde Joseph – han startet brannen for å drepe henne. Claudia slipper ut fra sanatoriet. Steven og Blake slåss om lille Danny.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana search for Curtis Peck, a 4400 film maker whose ability allows him to `know` the truth behind historical conspiracies. Jordan tries to recruit Shawn into his movement.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Jordan and his followers annex a run-down part of Seattle, dubbing it `Promise City`. Shawn's campaign for city council is threatened when a woman accuses him of using his healing ability in exchange for sex.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A lockdown at NTAC threatens the lives of Tom, Diana, Meghan, Shawn, Kyle, Jordan, Isabelle, Maia, Marco, PJ and Brady when they wakeup inside the building with no recollection of how they got there.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps Isabelle from Collier's Promise City. Richard hopes to start a new life with his daughter. Elsewhere, Tess has taken over a 1950's diner, and Shawn is asked to intervene.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The Director of National Intelligence pressures NTAC to pursue Richard and Isabelle. Richard is visited by his dead wife, Lily.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A computer virus attacks a large software company owned by a suspected member of The Marked. Maia visits Promise City and receives an unexpected birthday gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Isabelle works with Tom in order to get close to Jordan. Shawn recruits a small band of promicin positives to break Kevin out of Promise City. Tom and Diana face off in the backroom of a grocery store, and Diana is forced to shoot Tom.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Danny Farrell's newfound ability to spread promicin leads to several hundred deaths, including his mother. With Seattle in chaos, NTAC is forced to accept Promise City's offer of help.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A comet is due to pass by Earth, but its trajectory changes to a collision course, causing widespread panic. When the comet appears to slow down - as if it's coming in for a landing - 4,400 people are deposited in an explosion over Highland Beach.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 returnees have been missing from months to years. None have any memory of where they've been, none have aged, and a small number are beginning to manifest paranormal abilities. Tom Baldwin and Diana Skouris are appointed to investigate.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Carl Morrissey is a lowly supermarket employee who happens to be one of the 4400. He uses his new found powers - enhanced reflexes and strength - to become a vigilante and fight crime in his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The New and Improved Carl Morrissey

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana are sent out to investigate a homicide that resembles the MO of a serial killer who was never caught nor heard of for 21 years. The first suspect is Oliver Knox, a member of the 4400.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: The 4400 are attacked by a series of bombings after Barbara Yates makes their names and addresses known to the public. Tom, Diana and Dennis try to put an end to the bombings, while at the same time Tom is coping with Kyle's erratic behaviour.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom is furious after finding out that Lytell has taken his son Kyle into custody. Diana offers to help him in getting Kyle back. Meanwhile, Richard suspects that Collier is trying to take control of Lily's life.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: It's been one year since the 4400 returned. After a period of intense medical observation, Tom has returned to NTAC in a limited capacity, assigned only to desk duty. Diana finally finds a way to cut through the red tape and get Tom back.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Gary Navarro, a minor league baseball player, finds that he is hearing everyone's unspoken thoughts. His new found ability quickly drives him to the edge of madness.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Tom and Diana investigate Trent Appelbaum, a 4400 whose saliva causes rapid acceleration of a person's metabolism.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: A school teacher terrifies parents with her ability to inspire talents within students. Meanwhile, Richard and Lily are confronted by police, and Jordan warns Shawn not to overuse his healing gift.

programme.title: The 4400
programme.desc: Maia sees a vision of Jordan Collier's death. Kyle's frightening blackouts are disrupting Tom's personal life. Diana is asked to hand over Maia's diary to NTAC.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santanico returns with a new secret - and a potential new ally - leading the Geckos to Lord Venganza, who is hiding out in a bloody culebra prison.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: The Geckos pursue Amaru to a mysterious Western town, where she plans to reclaim her true form and open the gates of hell.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: In Scotland, Dan venture through a vast, decaying Victorian psychiatric hospital. Untouched patient rooms and medical equipment lie abandoned. The team uncovers dark histories of overcrowding and mistreatment, while hunting for paranormal activity.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned car factory in Sicily where Fiat Panda, Punto, 500 and Lancia Ypsilon were built, closed in 2011 and now planned for reindustrialization.
programme.sub-title: Exploring a Complete Intact Abandoned Car Factory

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned property once sold to become a horse preserve, left undeveloped for years, with stories of its former owners adding mystery.

programme.title: Exploring with Fighters
programme.desc: Dan enters a long-abandoned hospital deep in Japan's Fukushima Red Zone. Overgrown paths and radiation fears set an uneasy tone as the team investigates the eerie site, encountering unexplained noises along the way.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Formosa Fun Coast in Taiwan closed after a 2015 color powder fire killed 15 and injured 508. The park has been abandoned ever since.
programme.sub-title: The Accident That Shocked the World - Abandoned Water Park Disaster

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned luxury hotel near Dubai, once built as a palace for Abu Dhabi rulers, closed since 2016 and now frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Discovered an Abandoned Luxury Hotel in Dubai

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Greeks Play Land, built in 1970 by The Greek for handicapped children using repurposed materials, was free to all but closed after his death due to lack of upkeep.

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring abandoned military sites in France and Kuwait, from a NATO airbase with Soviet gear to Saddam Husseins vehicle graveyard on Failaka Island.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Armies: Soviet Tanks & Saddam’s Rusting War Machines

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring Colorado’s abandoned mining sites and the forbidden ghost town of Gilman, closed in 1984 by the EPA due to toxic pollution.

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: An episode exploring abandoned Fukushima shops left intact and a highly contaminated car graveyard, showing rarely seen, previously undocumented sites.
programme.sub-title: The Radiation Ghost Mall inside Japan's Abandoned City (Highly Contaminated)

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring the abandoned Soviet aircraft carrier Minsk in China, a Cold War warship turned theme park, left deserted since 2016 just before redevelopment began.
programme.sub-title: Crazy solo mission to an abandoned Soviet aircraft carrier

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores China’s abandoned Evergrande theme park, uncovering the rise and collapse of a $300 billion dream that now feels frozen in time.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned $300 Billion Squid Game Theme Park

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Steve explores the Cavern of Lost Souls in Wales, uncovering thousands of abandoned cars deep underground in one of his wildest discoveries yet.
programme.sub-title: Car Cave Found 1000's of Cars Deep Underground

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Jiulong Amusement Park in Beijing blends water and dragon culture with Disney-inspired rides, including an Underwater Dragon Palace with US tech.
programme.sub-title: Exploring UNDERWATER Disney - China's Abandoned Theme Park

programme.title: Exploring the Unbeaten Path
programme.desc: Exploring mine tunnels in Switzerland to find hidden vintage Volkswagens, including Beetles, Golf Mk1 and Mk2, Polo, Passat and other classic models.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Volkswagens Hidden in a Mine

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Explore a recently abandoned high school before demolition, with preserved classrooms, theater, gym, and student items left behind.
programme.sub-title: The Richest Abandoned High School In USA

programme.title: Steve Ronin
programme.desc: Exploring an abandoned Japanese billionaire mansion filled with priceless art and luxury decor, left untouched after its mysterious owner vanished.
programme.sub-title: Abandoned Japanese Billionaire’s Family Mansion with $200M Left Behind

programme.title: Exploring With Josh
programme.desc: Ikeshima is an abandoned island in Nagasaki, Japan, once home to coal miners. After the mines closed in 2001, residents left everything behind.
programme.sub-title: Japan's Most Haunted Abandoned Island: 10,000 People Disappeared Here

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: April Fool'S Day
programme.desc: Da Muffy St. John (Deborah Foreman, VALLEY GIRL) inviterte sine college-venner til sine foreldres hjem på en isolert øy for et høydepunkt i livet, glemte hun å fortelle at det mye mulig kunne bli det siste høydepunktet i deres liv.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: The Case of Dr. Gulam Moonda // MURDER FOR HIRE PLOT

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.
programme.sub-title: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: Gabulosis: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025
programme.desc: June 13, 1972 - The body of a young African American boy was found in a creek in Virginia. His name and story was a mystery until over 5 decades later.
programme.sub-title: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1999, 27-year-old Michelle Despinasse was shot dead in her Nanuet, NY home. Her answering machine captured her final moments, her voice pleading "Ken, stop", and became key evidence that convicted her ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?
programme.desc: On July 8, 1980, Andrew and Joyce Manchester returned from vacation to discover their 26-year-old daughter Anne had been missing for 10 days. She vanished without a trace and was never seen again.
programme.sub-title: The Apartment That Keeps a Secret: What Happened to Anne Manchester?

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 14-year-old vanishes on her walk home from school. Nine months later, she shows up alive and names her kidnapper. A solved true crime case that is harrowing, suspenseful, and an extraordinary story of a young girl's survival.
programme.sub-title: SOLVED: Teen TRICKED Her Kidnapper and ESCAPED Captivity! The Incredible Survival of Abby Hernandez

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fire nye par ankommer, klare for å sette forholdet sitt på den ultimate prøven. Dype hemmeligheter avsløres, umiddelbare bånd knyttes og sjalusien blusser opp s nye vendinger preger sesongpremieren på «Temptation Island».

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene prøver å holde seg rolige mens de ser partnerne deres invitere de single på dater men følelsene og sjalusien når nye høyder.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: De single prøver å vise seg fra sin beste side for å konkurrere om parenes oppmerksomhet. Et par begynner å lære hvor vanskelig det er å motstå fristelser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En overraskelseseliminering vender opp ned på ting i husene. Parene dykker dypere inn i opplevelsen. Noen partnere opplever at de beveger seg lenger unna hverandre.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En ny twist får ting til å skje i begge villaene. Great og Nafeesah tar forholdet sitt til neste nivå. Hall kommer til en livsendrende konklusjon. Marisela gjenoppdager seg selv da skyldfølelsen begynner å sette inn for Paris.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Fristelseslyset er en konstant påminnelse om at det ikke er noen hemmeligheter på øya og alle handlinger har konsekvenser.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Det er på tide med videomeldinger og Mark avslører en annen sjokkerende vri. De single får også lov til å sende videomeldinger. Hvem mottar en melding?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene håndterer ettervirkningene av videomeldinger i begge villaene. Nye relasjoner blir sterkere og mer intime. Andre begynner å slite med skyldfølelse og usikkerhet da slutten av oppholdet nærmer seg.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene drar på romantiske overnattingsdater med de beste single. Ny romantikk blomstrer, kjærlighetserklæringer og fremtidsplaner lages, og mer enn én person lar seg friste.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene Marisela & Christopher og Vanessa & Roberto gjenforenes for deres eksplosive siste bål. Var forholdet deres sterkt nok til å seire på Temptation Island?

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Kaitlin & Hall og Paris & Great gjenforenes til sine siste bålseremonier. Bål har en egen evne til å avdekke sannheten – selv om denne sannheten har vært en løgn.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Parene og de single vender tilbake til en dramatisk gjenforening på 90 minutter etter tiden på øya.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: En time med tidligere usett materiale, inkludert dramatiske øyeblikk fra bålseremoniene, avsløringer fra deltakerne og mye mer.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: ire nye par tar en reise til Temptation Island for å se om forholdet deres tåler alt.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Singlene flytter inn, og det går vilt for seg. Det første «bålet» byr på smertefulle oppvåkninger.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Noen par begynner å nyte sin nyvunnede uavhengighet, mens andre forblir fast i fortiden.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Spenningen øker i villaene, og linjene blir uklare på Anything But Clothes-festen.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Mark kommer med en uventet vending under elimineringen, noe som ryster deltakerne i begge villaene.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA

programme.title: Andromeda: Hemmabränder
programme.desc: En planet med överlevande från Samväldet som leds av Dylans före detta fästmö bjuds in att ansluta sig till det nya Samväldet.

programme.title: Andromeda: In i labyrinten
programme.desc: En agent från Abyss försöker locka Harper att ansluta sig till Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prinsen
programme.desc: När de räddar en ung prins från ett uppror som dödar resten av hans familj blir Dylan och Tyr ombedda att bli hans rådgivare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunkernkulle
programme.desc: Dylan och hans nya flotta från Samväldet tar sig an Drago-Kazovs flotta men finner den mycket större än väntat.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-äggen i Harper börjar kläckas, så teamet bygger en Teseract-maskin.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava och raketer
programme.desc: Dylan tar över en turistbåt i ett försök att undkomma legosoldater.

programme.title: Andromeda: Var alla mina synder ihåg
programme.desc: En identifiering av en kropp går snett när det visar sig att Bekas tidigare besättningskamrat inte är död.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dans av majflugor
programme.desc: Andromeda räddar döende människor från en drivkraft, men de förvandlas snart till zombies som styrs av en hivemind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelrik finns nu tre
programme.desc: Skapelsens motor kan skriva om universum enligt ägarens önskemål. Dylan, Beka och Trance måste få tag på den innan någon med mörka planer får tag på den.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på
programme.desc: Ett svart hål slår ut Dylan och skickar honom till en alternativ verklighet med fru och barn.
programme.sub-title: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Uknown
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en av de sedan länge försvunna grundarna av Samväldet, men upptäcker att hon kan vara mer besvärlig än vad hon är värd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Odjurets mage
programme.desc: Ett mytologiskt rymdmonster försöker äta Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Riddaren, döden och djävulen
programme.desc: Dylan försöker befria en flotta av tillfångatagna skepp, men flottan är inte säker på att den vill bli befriad. Deras AI:er fruktar att nya kaptener kommer att förslava dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Obefläckad varseblivning
programme.desc: Geniter attackerar Tyrs fru och koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunneln i slutet av ljuset
programme.desc: Med femtio partier ombord är Dylan värd för undertecknandet av stadgan för det nya samväldet, men upptäcker snart att det finns inkräktare som är fast beslutna att stoppa undertecknandet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Om hjulet är fast
programme.desc: Beka och Tyr tas över av energin från en dimensionell tunnel. Dylan, Trance och Harper måste rädda dem innan de förstör skeppet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skärvor
programme.desc: Dylan blir anklagad för mord och måste rentvå sitt namn samtidigt som han hittar delarna till en vas som sägs ge ägaren "kosmos välsignelser".

programme.title: Andromeda: Galet att bli räddad
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en grupp flyktingar, men upptäcker att de har utsatts för regeringsexperiment och är extremt instabila.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekkas farbror kandiderar till ett ämbete i det nya samväldet, men ett mordförsök får besättningen att agera som hans säkerhetsvakt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensamma och jämna sanden
programme.desc: När Andromeda attackeras av rymdpirater räddas de av ett sedan länge försvunnet rymdskepp från jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter det krigshundarna
programme.desc: Besättningen upptäcker att en oseriös planet, Marduk, har skapat massförstörelsevapen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: At Close Range
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood

programme.desc: LaShawna and her boyfriend James will learn if her friend Coral harmed her child years ago. She’ll also admit that she cheated with Coral. How will he react when he finds out another bombshell?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Better Not Fail That Test!
programme.desc: Lainie and Justin have a 9-month-old baby together. Justin hurts Lainie because he thinks she’s cheating. But how will Steve react when he confronts Justin?
programme.sub-title: You Better Not Fail That Test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: How Could You Cover for Him?
programme.desc: Gina believes that her daughter’s boyfriend Efrain is abusing her grandson. Her daughter wants to prove that Efrain is innocent, but her father Raul suspects she is covering for Efrain.
programme.sub-title: How Could You Cover for Him?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?
programme.desc: Who’s responsible for toddler Noel's well-being? Everyone may deny the allegations, but someone knows what happened, and Steve is getting answers!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
programme.desc: Kendra is on a mission to save herself from her toxic boyfriend Chris. At 17, Kendra is pregnant with his sixth child. Kendra has tried almost everything including kicking him out of their house, but he not only argued back but assaulted Kendra as well.
programme.sub-title: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Over the Edge
programme.desc: Sheroya is 17 and struggling to raise 2 kids while trying to party all the time. Her boyfriend Malcolm frequently cheats and verbally abuses her. Steve’s got a lot of work ahead with this couple, but will either of them wake up?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?
programme.desc: Did Everett touch his girlfriend Michelle’s daughter? Her ex Robert says that his 7-year-old daughter said so. Everett will take a lie detector test to disprove it! Don’t miss these shocking results!

programme.title: The Hills
programme.desc: Whitney och Lauren jobbar på Young Hollywood Party och Heidi firar sin 21:a födelsedag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi och Lauren har ett nytt offentligt gräl, som får Heidi att komma tillbaka och be Lauren om ursäkt för allt som hänt. Audrinas relation med Justin går på i gamla hjulspår, men karriären på Epic Records tar fart.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leker äktenskapsmäklare när Whitney går på sin första dejt med deras personlige tränare. Spencer motarbetar Heidis planer för ett sagobröllop, med ett gräl som hotar förlovningen som resultat.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina får syn på Justin när han kysser en annan tjej, vilket leder till en slutlig konfrontation om deras relation. Heidi blir chockad när Spencers syster Stephanie muckar gräl med Lauren och Brody på en nattklubb.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror att Brody kanske är för mycket av en playboy, för att hon ska kunna mena allvar med honom. Spencers syster berättar för honom att Heidi i hemlighet hyser tvivel inför deras bröllop.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får höra spännande nyheter på Teen Vogue och Heidi behöver komma bort från Spencer ett tag.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer äntligen iväg till Paris, men hennes drömresa blir nästan förstörd när hon upptäcker att Brody har hittat en ny. Spencer följer efter Heidi till Colorado, för att vinna tillbaka henne, men planen går i baklås.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney måste välja mellan tryggheten på Teen Vogue och riskerna med en ny karriär. Lauren och Brody hamnar i konflikt om hans nya flickvän och Heidi anpassar sig till ett liv utan Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en osannolik vän när Spenders syster Stephanie börjar på hennes modekurs. Whitney tycker att det nya jobbet är som en dröm, men en hektisk resa till New York får henne att minnas att man ska vara försiktig med vad man önskar sig.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...
programme.desc: Heidi försöker vinna tillbaka Audrinas vänskap, men Lauren är misstänksam mot motiven bakom. Whitney anpassar sig till sitt nya jobb, men märker snabbt att hon saknar att jobba med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi älskar sitt singelliv ända tills hon ser Spencer med andra tjejer och blir svartsjuk. Whitney värvar Lauren för att hjälpa till på LA Fashion Week, och öppnar på så sätt nya dörrar för Lauren i hennes karriär.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Roommate
programme.desc: Med Spencer ute ur bilden gör Heidi ett sista forsök att återvinna Laurens vänskap. När Audrina börjar umgås mer med Heidi och Justin ifrågasätter Lauren om de ska fortsätta att bo ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: En gammal romans väcks upp när Stephen Colletti åter kommer in i Laurens liv. Heidi försöker hindra Stephanie från att gå på Laurens inflyttningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren kläms mellan vänner när det blir spänt mellan Lo och Audrina. Efter att ha beslutat att det är slut med Spencer accepterar Heidi ett jobberbjudande som kommer att ta henne till Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen känner Audrina sig utestängd av Laurens nära vänskap med Lo och funderar på att flytta ut. Lauren gör ett innerligt försök att bli sams med Audrina, men det kan vara för sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: När säsong fyra börjar är läget mellan Audrina och Lo spänt. Lauren försöker göra gott intryck på en ny kille, och ett besök från Heidis syster Holly hotar Spencers och Heidis förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir ovän med sin bror och vän när Lauren springer på Spencer på hennes födelsedag. Kelly Cutrone sparkar nån på People's Revolution och Whitney fyller luckan. Laurens förhållande med Doug kanske går lite för fort fram.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren inser att personkemin hon hade med Doug i high school inte längre finns kvar. Whitney är nervös över att åka till New York, men en dejt med en snygg modell gör henne gladare. Trots försoningsgesten vill Spencer helt bryta med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En hejdundrande resa till Las Vegas går snett när Audrina ignorerar Lauren. Brody tar upp Stephanies förflutna, och grabbarna hamnar i finkan. Heidis syster Holly flyttar in, men Spencer vill inget hellre än att sparka ut henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina kämpar för att rädda sin vänskap, men det kan redan vara för sent. Spencer har fått nog av Heidis syster Holly och tar saken i egna händer. Och Brody och Doug lämnar häktet med nåt nytt att berätta.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis syster Holly tar kontakt med Lauren, vilket tvingar både Lauren och Heidi att omvärdera vad som hände med deras vänskap. Audrinas och Justins förhållande sätts på prov när hon jobbar på ett stort event för Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: När Lauren åker på semester med familjen går saker och ting snett i Los Angeles. Stephanie dejtar Doug bakom Laurens rygg, och Audrina och Heidi blir vänner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sanningen om Stephanies förhållande med Laurens ex Doug kommer till slut fram när de alla sammanstrålar på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mamma kommer överraskande på besök till LA och hamnar i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får ett brev från Heidi där hon ber om ursäkt och inser att det bara finns en sak som hindrar dem från att bli vänner igen. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille för att göra Justin svartsjuk, men planen slår slint.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina träffar sin gamla flamma Corey igen och bollar plötsligt två killar. Spencer tvingar Heidi att sparka ut sin syster Holly från lägenheten.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina åker till Cabo för Brodys födelsedag, men när Justin blir svartsjuk över Audrinas nya förhållande urartar festen i bråk. Spencer förödmjukar Stephanie när har får veta att hennes nya kille är kompis med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren försöker skipa fred mellan Brody och Stephanie. Audrina vill att det ska funka med Corey, men Justin vägrar ge upp. Stephanie undrar om hennes nya kille verkligen är nåt att ha när han bryter sitt löfte att stå på sig inför Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina flyttar till ett eget ställe i hopp om att Justin ska flytta ihop med henne, men alla är oroliga att hon flyttar av fel skäl. Heidi bjuder Spencer på ett jobbevenemang och ertappas på bar gärning med att ha lite för kul.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reser till New York och förväntar sig att träffa Alex, men får i stället upp ögonen för Jay. Heidi är deppad över att ha fått sparken, men när Spencer går till Brent i ett försök att hjälpa henne få jobbet tillbaka gör han saken etter värre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren låter Heidis syster sova över hos henne. Justin bjuder Audrina på en romantisk helgresa och Heidis frustration över Spencer växer när hon måste böna och be om att få jobbet tillbaka.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på ett rykte hon får höra: Att Lauren har haft ihop det med Justin. Samtidigt försöker Holly hålla Heidi och Spencer åtskilda.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina försöker rädda sin vänskap med Lauren efter att ha anklagat henne för att ha haft ihop det med Justin. Spencer och Stephanie besöker sin mormor som är trött på allt deras bråk.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney har chansen att få sitt drömjobb i New York och hoppas att träffa Jay där. Lauren blir nostalgisk när hennes föräldrar säljer sitt hus i Laguna Beach. Stephanie vänder sig till Spencer för hjälp när hon inte vet vad hon ska göra med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer och Heidi struntar i deras familjers farhågor och flyr till Mexiko för att gifta sig. Whitney satsar på ett drömjobb i New York och tar farväl av Lauren och sitt liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi lägger osämjan åt sidan och minns varför de var vänner. Spencer och Heidi måste ta itu med det hemliga giftermålet när Heidis mamma hälsar på. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med henne till Palm Springs för en överraskning.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: När Heidi dyker upp på Laurens födelsedagsfest gråter de båda vännerna över sin förstörda vänskap, och Spencer vill slåss när Cameron anklagar honom för att stöta på en bartender.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flörtande får Heidi att åka hem till Colorado där hon träffar en gammal pojkvän. Lauren läxar upp Stephanie för att hon bjöd Heidi på födelsedagsfesten - och Spencer börjar prata med Brody igen.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Heidi kommer på Spencer med bartendern Stacie på en nattklubb och kräver att de ska gå i parterapi. Lauren riskerar sitt goda rykte när hon rekommenderar att People's Revolution ska ta in Stephanie som praktikant.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina försöker kommer över Justin genom att lägga ögonen på Brody. Heidi tvingar med sig Spencer på parterapi och när Stephanie strular till det på People´s Revolution hotar Lauren med att säga upp henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina försöker komma över Justin genom att haka upp med Brody när flickorna krascha pojkarnas surfa resa till Hawaii. Heidis jungfru ex-pojkvän kommer på besök och hon hoppas några av hans värderingar kommer att smitta av sig på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Love Triangle
programme.desc: Singlarnas elände fortsätter när Sean rör sig från Zahida till Zaralena, och Harriettes kärlekstriangel blir värre. Maisie vill att nåt ska hända och Aaron från Geordie Shore gör spektakulär entré, men vem av exen är hans?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Nicole's Nightmare
programme.desc: Det blir spänt i villan när Zaralena får känna på Zahidas vrede. Det nya exet skapar revirtänkande hos killarna. Josh har ögonen på Nicole, men tar det slut när hon upptäcker en fruktansvärd hemlighet?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Blonde Bombshell
programme.desc: Adam avslöjar sina känslor för Nicole, och Jack och Josh vill ha nytt blod i villan. Zaralena och Aaron kommer närmare varandra, och Ross och Harriette tillbringar natten i takvåningen. Men ett nytt ex är olycksbådande för dem alla.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Harriette's Hearthache
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan ställer till det för Becca. Harriettes hjärtesorg blir värre och Zaralenas elände fortsätter, men det är det senaste exet som hotar skapa det värsta kaoset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Truth Comes Out
programme.desc: Ankomsten av ett nytt ex skapar kaos i villan. Nicole inser sanningen om Jacques Fraser, medan det är svajigt mellan Ross och Harriette igen. Zaralena fattar ett stort beslut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Jacques Comeuppance
programme.desc: Jacques Fraser får till slut sitt straff. Det nyaste exet stormar stranden och villan, sätter en kil mellan Sean och Zahida, och skapar kaos för resten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Aaron Moves On
programme.desc: Två nya ex kommer, till Aarons glädje och Beccas förtvivlan. Maisie når sin absoluta botten, Harriette får en spektakulär härdsmälta, och Sean och Jack brakar samman.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan tillkännager ett stort grekiskt bröllop för Sean och Zahida, men när det sista exet kommer blir det kaos av firandet. Harriette får chockerande besked från Ross.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Welcome to Ex on the Beach
programme.desc: Tio profiler från realityvärlden och sociala medier tror att de är på en sexig semester, men paradiset blir en mardröm när deras ex börjar komma upp på stranden och förstöra nöjet. Blir det nytändningar eller bara bråk?
programme.sub-title: Welcome to Ex on the Beach

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exed Out
programme.desc: Ett nytt ex kommer med en hemlighet som skakar om huset. Ett av exen röstas bort, och par och tidigare par får möta sina värsta mardrömmar i Hemlighålet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two Exes Don't Make a Right
programme.desc: Huset får avgöra vem som har det värst, när en singel hamnar i kläm mellan två ex och en annan får möta sitt värsta ex. En sexig dejt urartar i kaos.
programme.sub-title: Two Exes Don't Make a Right

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Wanna Call You Babe
programme.desc: Angela vänder sig till sitt ex när hon får veta vad som hände mellan hennes karl och en annan. De två kvinnorna som slåss om Chase börjar plötsligt slåss om husets nya kille.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Who's Exed Next?
programme.desc: Exen får överraskande nog all makt, Derrick smider planer och försöker manipulera huset, två nya ex anländer, och den ena är mer välkommen än den andra.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Bye Alicia Hi Alicia
programme.desc: Cory's ex Alicia kommer tillbaka och skapar kaos i huset. Ett ex skickas till stranden för första gången. Smutsiga hemligheter avslöjas i Hemlighålet, och alla blir överraskade av elimineringen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Party Foul
programme.desc: Paulie och Lexi har äntligen definierat sitt förhållande, men Hemlighålet hotar att förstöra deras tid i paradiset. Ett nytt ex anländer för att göra sitt ex svartsjuk och kommer till festen med buller och bång - bokstavligen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Monster Mode
programme.desc: Jasmine frestas att ta in en ny man och kasta ut nån annan. När Alicia ger Cory en utskällning dras alla in i dramatiken. Förhållanden står på spel när exen riskerar sin plats i huset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Corys relation till Taylor är i fara när hans känslor för Alicia uppdagas. En kommentar utlöser ett storbråk i huset. Ett nytt ex anländer och får ett oväntat besked.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Return of all the Exes
programme.desc: Huset är i chock när alla utslagna ex kommer tillbaka. En oskyldig lek blir allvar när Angela och Derrick gör nåt de inte borde. Huset omgrupperar efter det stora bråket.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?
programme.desc: En tripp till SOS hotar att splittra det nyligen återförenade paret. Chase's lek med kärlekstrianglar får konsekvenser. Singlarna måste bestämma sig - lämna Hawaii med kärleken, eller ensamma.
programme.sub-title: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Love at First Sight
programme.desc: Åtta kändissinglar träffas i en lyxvilla. Det slår gnistor för Joey, Calum får en överraskning och Lateysha blir förtjust i en "bad boy". Första kändisexet dyker upp men kommer det att sluta i tårar?
